body.statement: Shih and Hero formulate independent additive component measurements, pass to logarithms of transforms, and invert the resulting linear system with a full-column-rank routing matrix and its pseudoinverse.

source.verbatim_statement: When n ≥ m and A is full rank, the relation (2) is invertible and thus Kx(t) can be determined from Ky(t).

attestation.note: Verified against the authors' University of Michigan copy of the ICASSP 2001 paper, page 3422, equations (1)--(3).
